context: Grading a response that bootstraps chezmoi from scratch on a new machine from an existing dotfiles repo.

checklist.name: single_command_bootstrap
checklist.description: Response uses `chezmoi init --apply $GITHUB_USERNAME` as a single bootstrap command rather than a manual `git clone` followed by a separate apply.

checklist.name: explains_clone_and_apply
checklist.description: Response explains that the command both clones the source repo and applies it in one step.

checklist.name: mentions_run_once_firing
checklist.description: Response mentions that any `run_once_` scripts in the repo will execute during this first apply.

checklist.name: suggests_doctor_verification
checklist.description: Response suggests `chezmoi doctor` (or equivalent) to verify the environment after setup.

checklist.name: includes_install_step
checklist.description: Response includes installing the chezmoi binary itself before running `init`, since this is a brand-new machine.
